dag_infos.description: New Taipei divorce population age structure rates by gender. The 15-19 and 35-39 bands cross the 18-35 boundary; the source rates are retained and no 18-35 rate is materialized.

data_infos.name_cn: 新北市離婚人口年齡結構比（按性別）
data_infos.source_type: 新北市資料開放平臺 API
data_infos.dataset_description: 新北市15歲以上離婚人口按年齡組與性別的結構比，2006–2024逐年資料。各性別年齡組加總為100%。
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch the JSON array with a browser User-Agent, resolve field1 and percent2-percent13 by their documented age/gender roles, parse each age band into integer bounds, verify each gender distribution sums to 100, and retain source rates only. The source is value_type=rate: do not population-scale rates and do not materialize an 18-35 rate without numerator/denominator information. A three-times-median annual scale guard fails on unknown scope changes.
